parsedVerdict.reasoning: Most of PayrollService belongs in the business (domain) layer. It checks payroll rules (weekly hours must be 0–80, the employee must be active, only approved timesheets are paid), coordinates the Timesheet approve() transition, and builds payslips with Payslip.compute. Calls to the repository objects are orchestration, not persistence logic. Whether it is allowed to depend on the persistence classes is a dependency-direction question, so I did not judge it. The problem is the public method `run(week: string, request?: Request)`. It takes an Express HTTP `Request`, which is a transport/framework concept that belongs to the presentation layer. The parameter is never used, but it puts HTTP framework concerns into the domain service's contract. Every caller must deal with a web-framework type, and the domain operation is tied to HTTP transport. That is presentation-layer responsibility inside a domain file. My confidence is moderate because the parameter is unused, so no transport logic actually runs.
